purpose: Form STK-7 is used for the notice issued by the Registrar pursuant to the action initiated under sub-section (1) of section 248.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Receive notice in Form No. STK-7 issued by the Registrar pursuant to the action initiated under sub-section (1) of section 248.
checklist: Check if notice in Form No. STK-7 has been issued by the Registrar.
watch: Once notice in Form No. STK-7 has been issued by the Registrar, a company shall not be allowed to file an application in Form No. STK-2.
